invariants.name: immutable draft creation
invariants.description: Creating a Scene yields draft_pending at revision one with no approval or failure origin, and neither retained input aliases nor exposed snapshots can mutate aggregate state.
invariants.test_case_name: creates a draft scene at revision one with an immutable configuration snapshot

tasks.title: Implement the canonical lifecycle and failure recovery
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/src/scene.test.ts -t "allows every canonical scene transition|rejects representative transitions|treats completed and cancelled|records failure origin|returns an immutable QA rejection"

signature_changes.note: Adds named lifecycle methods returning immutable SceneTransition facts.

invariants.name: canonical transition matrix
invariants.description: Every PRD 4.2 edge is reachable through its named behavior and produces the expected destination and reason.
invariants.test_case_name: allows every canonical scene transition through its behavior method

invariants.name: forbidden transition atomicity
invariants.description: A non-terminal transition absent from the canonical matrix throws InvalidTransitionError and leaves the full snapshot unchanged.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects representative transitions absent from the canonical matrix

invariants.name: terminal lifecycle enforcement
invariants.description: Every lifecycle behavior invoked in completed or cancelled throws TerminalStateError and leaves state unchanged.
invariants.test_case_name: treats completed and cancelled scenes as terminal

invariants.name: failure provenance and retry authorization
invariants.description: Failure records its source; only queued, rendering, or QA failures retaining current approval may retry directly to queued, while generation failure must recover to review or cancel.
invariants.test_case_name: records failure origin and permits only approved production failures to retry

invariants.name: QA rejection transition evidence
invariants.description: Rejecting QA clears current approval, enters director_review, and returns a frozen qa-to-director_review fact that later activity cannot alter.
invariants.test_case_name: returns an immutable QA rejection transition without erasing prior state facts

tasks.title: Enforce revision-bound approval and creative mutation rules

signature_changes.note: Adds explicit prompt, references, engine, duration, and LoRA mutation methods returning SceneTransition facts.

invariants.name: revision-bound approval
invariants.description: Approval is accepted only in director_review and freezes the exact current revision with the caller-supplied actor and timestamp.
invariants.test_case_name: binds approval metadata to the current scene revision

invariants.name: approved creative mutation invalidation
invariants.description: Each prompt, references, engine, duration, or LoRA update advances revision once, clears approval, applies only its named replacement, and moves approved to director_review.
invariants.test_case_name: invalidates approval for every creative mutation

invariants.name: editable-state revision progression
invariants.description: Creative updates in draft_pending or director_review advance revision while leaving lifecycle state unchanged.
invariants.test_case_name: keeps editable non-approved scenes in place while advancing revision

invariants.name: busy-state mutation rejection
invariants.description: Creative updates during generation, queueing, rendering, QA, or failure throw InvalidMutationError before changing any state.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects creative mutation during generation and production

invariants.name: terminal mutation rejection
invariants.description: Every creative update in completed or cancelled throws TerminalStateError and leaves configuration, revision, approval, failure origin, and status unchanged.
invariants.test_case_name: rejects every creative mutation in terminal states
